import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create the DataFrame from the provided data
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "AlterV10Lang": ["30- bis 39-Jährige"] * 5,
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a count plot of the number of dogs by year and district
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='StichtagDat', hue='KreisLang', palette='viridis')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Year and District', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='District')

# Save the figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
